questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Software Engineering Fundamentals & Software Process Models (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, Scrum)
questions.text: Explain Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) models: Classical Waterfall Model, Prototyping Model, Evolutionary (Iterative) Model, and Boehm's Spiral Model (Risk management in four quadrants). Compare their strengths, weaknesses, and suitability.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Software Engineering Fundamentals & Software Process Models (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, Scrum)
questions.text: Explain Agile Software Development principles according to the Agile Manifesto. Explain the Scrum Framework: Scrum Roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Cross-functional Dev Team), Artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Increment, Burn-Down Chart), and Ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Software Engineering Fundamentals & Software Process Models (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, Scrum)
questions.text: Explain Requirements Engineering processes: Inception, Elicitation (Interviews, Surveys, JAD, Observation), Analysis & Negotiation, Specification (Software Requirements Specification - SRS document conforming to IEEE 830 standard), and Validation. What makes a good SRS?

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: System Modeling & UML Diagrams (Use Case, Class, Sequence, Activity, Statechart)
questions.text:
Construct Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams for an Online Ride Sharing System (e.g. Pathao / InDrive):
(a) Use Case Diagram with `<<include>>` and `<<extend>>` relationships
(b) Class Diagram showing classes, attributes, operations, multiplicity, associations, and composition
(c) Sequence Diagram for user booking a ride and driver accepting.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Software Requirements Engineering (SRS, Functional/Non-Functional, Feasibility)
questions.text: Explain fundamental software design principles: Modularity, Abstraction, Information Hiding, High Cohesion, and Low Coupling. Explain types of Cohesion (Functional, Sequential, Communicational, Procedural, Temporal, Logical, Coincidental) and types of Coupling (Data, Stamp, Control, External, Common, Content).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Software Engineering Fundamentals & Software Process Models (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, Scrum)
questions.text: Explain Software Architectural Styles: Layered Architecture, Client-Server (2-Tier / 3-Tier), Model-View-Controller (MVC), Pipe-and-Filter, and Event-Driven / Microservices Architecture.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Architectural Design, Component Design & Design Patterns
questions.text: Explain Black Box (Behavioral) Testing techniques: (a) Equivalence Class Partitioning (ECP - Valid and invalid partitions), and (b) Boundary Value Analysis (BVA - Min, Min+, Nom, Max-, Max). Design black-box test cases for an input field accepting age integer between $18$ and $60$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Software Verification & Validation (Unit, Integration, System, Black/White Box Testing)
questions.text: Explain White Box (Structural) Testing: Statement Coverage, Branch / Decision Coverage, Condition Coverage, and Path Coverage. Draw the Control Flow Graph (CFG) for a given C function. Calculate McCabe's Cyclomatic Complexity: $V(G) = E - N + 2P$ and list all linearly independent execution paths.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Software Verification & Validation (Unit, Integration, System, Black/White Box Testing)
questions.text: Explain Software Testing Levels: Unit Testing (Mocking / Stubs & Drivers), Integration Testing (Top-Down with stubs vs Bottom-Up with drivers vs Big-Bang), System Testing, and Acceptance Testing (Alpha vs Beta testing). What is Regression Testing?

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Software Project Management, Cost Estimation (COCOMO), Risk Analysis & Quality Assurance
questions.text: Explain Boehm's COnstructive COst MOdel (COCOMO): Basic COCOMO, Intermediate COCOMO, and Detailed COCOMO. State formulas for Effort ($E = a \times (KLOC)^b\,\text{person-months}$) and Development Time ($D = c \times (E)^d\,\text{months}$) across Organic, Semi-Detached, and Embedded project modes. Calculate effort and nominal duration for an Organic project of size $40\,\text{KLOC}$ ($a = 2.4, b = 1.05, c = 2.5, d = 0.38$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Software Engineering Fundamentals & Software Process Models (Waterfall, Spiral, Agile, Scrum)
questions.text: Explain Software Maintenance categories: Corrective, Adaptive, Perfective, and Preventive maintenance. Explain Software Configuration Management (SCM) baseline, change control board (CCB), and version control systems (Git). Explain DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Software Verification & Validation (Unit, Integration, System, Black/White Box Testing)
